date_note: The page gives no earlier day than its own publication day; it describes the outage as happening on Tuesday 24 November.
title: TikTok outage hits users in the US and UK; company cites a 'brief technical issue'
geo_basis: country: the article reports users in the US and UK
summary: IBTimes reports that TikTok users in the US and UK saw missing videos, broken feeds and 'Something went wrong' errors on Tuesday 24 November. A TikTok spokesperson confirmed a 'brief technical issue' affected access, as quoted by IBTimes. TikTok did not disclose a cause, and the article says no evidence links the outage to a cyberattack.
plain: TikTok users in the US and UK saw errors and missing videos on 24 November. TikTok told IBTimes a brief technical issue affected access. No cause was given.
exec: A TikTok spokesperson, quoted by IBTimes, confirmed a brief technical issue; no cause was disclosed.

validation.note: One publisher (IBTimes UK) relaying TikTok's spokesperson statement; no TikTok or status page was read.
